 Increased incentives will boost consumer demand at the end of the year.
 The Ho Chi Minh City retail market is entering its most vibrant period of 2026 and looking forward to the Lunar New Year of 2027. Immediately after the launch of the large-scale consumer stimulus program “Shopping Season in Vibrant HCMC,” a reporter from SGGP newspaper interviewed Mr. Nguyen Nguyen Phuong, Deputy Director of the Ho Chi Minh City Department of Industry and Trade, about the program to stimulate demand, ensure supply, and stabilize market prices.
 Báo Sài Gòn Giải phóng • 15/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 * REPORTER: Sir, the "Shopping Season in Vibrant HCMC" program has just launched with a promotional package worth over 250 billion VND. What is the biggest breakthrough of this year's year-end shopping season compared to previous years? 
 Mr. Nguyen Nguyen Phuong, Deputy Director of the Ho Chi Minh City Department of Industry and Trade - Mr. NGUYEN NGUYEN PHUONG: The fundamental difference in this year's shopping season is the shift from individual promotions to a multi-channel stimulus campaign, closely connecting traditional commerce, digital spaces, and tourism .
 For the first time, the series of events will span from mid-November 2026 to February 2027 (through the Lunar New Year of the Goat 2027) with approximately 97 concentrated promotional activities, bringing together more than 100 major brands, 66 shopping malls, and about 5,000 sales points across the area.
 The city allows businesses to apply promotions up to 100%, expecting to generate a total transaction value of over 30 trillion VND and stimulate demand by an additional 10 trillion - 11 trillion VND.
 Besides modern retail systems and over 500 branded stores belonging to the Inter Pacific Group (IPPG) offering simultaneous discounts, the Department of Industry and Trade also collaborated with e-commerce platforms such as Shopee to organize Mega Sale livestreams, launching a series of super vouchers with deep discounts of up to 700,000 - 720,000 VND.
 Furthermore, the collaboration of financial institutions, banks, and airlines (such as HDBank , Vietjet, Vikki...) helps expand cashless payment incentives, transforming Ho Chi Minh City into an attractive shopping and entertainment destination for both locals and international tourists.
 * Strong stimulus measures will lead to a surge in consumer demand. How have the Ministry of Industry and Trade and businesses prepared their supply of goods and price stabilization measures to serve the market? 
 - In the first 10 months of 2026, Ho Chi Minh City's total retail sales of goods and consumer service revenue reached nearly 1.68 trillion VND, an increase of 14.7% compared to the same period last year. This is a very positive sign but also places significant pressure on the supply chain, as the city currently serves approximately 15 million people, consuming tens of thousands of tons of food daily. To proactively secure supply, the city has activated its market stabilization plan early on.
 You may also like Major wholesale businesses such as Saigon Co.op , SATRA, MM Mega Market, GO!, Vissan… have prepared goods worth approximately 30,000 billion VND for the two peak months of Tet, of which price-stabilized goods account for about 13,000 billion VND, an increase of 10% - 20% depending on the essential item.
 A new feature in this year's operating method is the increased flexibility and the fragmentation of the production-inventory cycle. Instead of concentrating production all at once, which can easily lead to cost pressures or inventory buildup, businesses are dividing it into multiple stages, closely monitoring the actual purchasing power of each distribution system.
 Price-stabilized goods continue to uphold their commitment to being at least 5% lower than similar products on the market, acting as an anchor to maintain overall price stability. 
 Customers shop at a supply and demand matching event held at Phu Tho Stadium (Ho Chi Minh City).
 Photo: GIA HAN * How does the Ho Chi Minh City Department of Industry and Trade ensure that price-stabilized goods reach workers in remote areas while simultaneously protecting consumers from the problem of substandard products? 
 - We are implementing two solutions simultaneously: expanding distribution coverage and tightening quality control at the source. Currently, Ho Chi Minh City has a dense retail network with 66 shopping malls, 300 supermarkets, 405 traditional markets, over 3,650 convenience stores, and more than 12,000 price-stabilized retail outlets.
 In industrial zones, worker housing areas, and suburban regions, the Department of Industry and Trade continues to strengthen mobile sales trips combined with Vietnamese goods fairs, directly bringing price-stabilized and promotional goods to serve middle- and low-income workers.
 Regarding quality control, the "Responsible Green Tick" program is proving exceptionally effective and has become a pillar of trust for consumers. Data updated as of November 12th shows the program's strong spread in Ho Chi Minh City and other localities, attracting 1,388 suppliers with 14,906 registered products.
 Simultaneously, the Ho Chi Minh City Market Management Force, in coordination with the economic police and 168 wards, communes, and special zones, intensified surprise inspections of warehouses and processing facilities. Local authorities were required to report daily price fluctuations for fresh food items to facilitate timely adjustments and resolutely prevent hoarding and localized price gouging.
 You may also like * In the context of Ho Chi Minh City setting a target of double-digit economic growth in 2026 and building momentum for 2027, what are your expectations for the domestic market's rebound in the coming months? 
 - The city aims for a 13.84% growth in the service sector this year, therefore the fourth quarter of 2026 and the first quarter of 2027 are crucial. Consumers are now spending more intelligently and practically: they are willing to shop generously but prioritize products with transparent origins, reasonable prices, and a rich experience.
 When the government builds infrastructure to promote digital trade, and businesses accept reduced profit margins to offer deep discounts and strictly control product quality, I believe purchasing power at the end of 2026 and during the Lunar New Year of 2027 will surge strongly. The greatest aspiration of the Ministry of Industry and Trade is to create a vibrant yet safe, modern, and humane market.
 Whether in the city center or the surrounding areas, the approximately 15 million people of Ho Chi Minh City can access quality goods at good prices, ensuring they can enjoy the festive season and Tet holiday to the fullest.
